9eead9c2c6: Why net worth matters more than income
c049abed3f: Income measures cash flow; net worth measures your actual financial position. Someone with a high income but heavy debt and little saved can have a lower net worth than someone with a modest income and steady saving habits. Tracking it over time — quarterly or yearly — shows whether you're moving in the right direction. Home equity and retirement accounts count toward net worth but aren't easy to spend, which is why liquid assets are shown separately.
